newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goodyear, Bridgestone seek offers, spot RSS3 done.
newsitem.headline: Goodyear, Bridgestone seek offers, spot RSS3 done.

text.p: Goodyear and Bridgestone were said to be seeking offers on Wednesday in the Singapore rubber market while one manufacturer was said to have clinched a deal for spot RSS3 rubber, dealers said.
"I think they're both trying to get offers. Goodyear is fishing for some offers this afternoon," one dealer said.
"But I don't think any deals were done," another trader said. Both companies were said to be looking for SIR20 rubber at prices between 50-52 U.S. cents a kg, dealers said.
One tyre company here managed to clinch a deal for spot RSS3 rubber at around 118.00-119.00 U.S. cents a kg, a dealer said.
"It's enough to pay for our monthly expenses. But overseas buying is still a bit thin," another trader said.
"That's a surprise. I thought they were not going to buy today," one dealer said. Traders said market conditions remained a bit dull, with no major deals reported.
At around 0945 GMT, May RSS3 was seen at 118.50 U.S. cents a kg from 119.50 cents. July RSS1 was seen at 173.00-175.00 Singapore cents (US$1.20-$1.21) a kg from 175.25 cents.
October/December TSR20 was seen at 117.00 U.S. cents a kg from 117.50 cents. -- (US$1-S$1.44) Rene Pastor (65-8703305)
